description: Skelet AF-08-i board REST routes over the ordered collections domain

compatibility.instructions: Does adding boards.ts plus 5 REST routes change any existing envelope, route, MCP tool, migration, or dependency? New files only; collections domain read through existing authorized functions; no ledger change. Do existing callers keep working?

correctness.instructions: Is the layer factually correct: field allowlists per operation, UUID/title/visibility/position validation, workspace-locator aliasing rejection, invalid-collection to INVALID_INPUT with safe messages versus opaque denial for auth/unknown/cross-tenant, ordered items in get/save/move responses, deterministic remove/replay, move out-of-range delegated to the store? Are the fixed issues (route import depth, exactOptionalPropertyTypes spreads) genuinely resolved with typecheck/build green?

evidence.instructions: Are the 4 tests sufficient: full lifecycle with stable URIs and rank assertions, validation matrix with envelope checks, tenant isolation across all 7 operations plus aliasing and laundering denial, no-model scan? Typecheck/lint/build green?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism: store-owned ordering/transactions, no timing, idempotent save/remove? Any route-level retry or duplicate-delivery hole?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond board REST: new capture, MCP tools, UI page, paid services, or unrelated refactors? Is the UI page correctly left to AF-08-ii?

security.instructions: Does the layer preserve server-side authority: membership-resolved actorId, opaque alike-denials, laundering guard via read gate, aliasing rejection, bearer/rate-limit guards in routes, no secrets or remote code?

state.change: AF-08-i: boards.ts REST layer (list/create/get/update/delete/save/remove/move) with 5 routes and 4 tests; UI deferred to AF-08-ii.
